recon.oracleCaptureRecipe:
RECIPE to capture the oracle that PREDICTS pos21 (token 3425 ` files`):

WHAT IT MUST BE: a no-spec SEQUENTIAL rank-1 DECODE whose FINAL decoded row is the next-token predictor for served pos21. pos21's predictor row = the row scoring context = prompt2_ids + served[0:21] (i.e. the served prefix up through pos20). The layer payload (layers[i]['hidden'/'residual'], 'rows', 'layer_idx', 'final_norm_hidden') captured at THAT row is the splice source.

SERVER: separate NO-SPEC boot, NOT the cat9 tree boot. Launch scripts/fr10_launch_speed_server.sh (or fr13_launch_forked_fa2_tree_server.sh) with FR12_NO_SPECULATIVE_CONFIG=1, ENFORCE_EAGER=1, ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASH_ATTN (no TREE_ATTN, no speculative_config) so regular greedy decode = sequential rank-1 ground truth. This is exactly how recur_oracle_pos849.pt was produced (boot.sh comment: "RECURRENT (no-spec sequential rank-1 DECODE)"), only the position was wrong.

CAPTURE (FR10 layer-capture hook, _fr10_layer_hidden_capture_start/_layer/_finish):
  export FR10_LAYER_HIDDEN_CAPTURE=/logs/recur_oracle_pos21.pt
  export FR10_LAYER_HIDDEN_CAPTURE_NUM_TOKENS=1   # the single-token teacher-forced decode forward = num_tokens 1
  export FR10_LAYER_HIDDEN_CAPTURE_ROWS=          # empty => all rows; with nt=1 the only/last row is row 0
  export FR10_LAYER_HIDDEN_CAPTURE_SKIP=0         # tune so the captured nt=1 forward is the pos21 request (see below)
  export FR10_LAYER_HIDDEN_CAPTURE_LIMIT=1
Then issue a teacher-forced request that scores exactly context = prompt2_ids + served[0:21] and decodes max_tokens=1 (mirror fr13_oracle_capture.py _tf_one: /v1/completions, prompt=context_ids list, max_tokens=1, temperature=0.0, top_p=1.0, seed=1313, logprobs=20, vllm_xargs fr10_decode_mode tree_mtp inert on no-spec). served[0:21] = the first 21 served tokens of prompt2 from THIS boot's stream (p2_served_ids.json[:21] = [271,248068,271,248069,271,40,3172,1151,539,23218,279,26622,310,3418,279,1970,3051,321,23748,279,9468]). The emitted token MUST be 3425 (` files`); assert it (this is the oracle-side positive check). To make the captured nt=1 forward be exactly the pos21 request and not the prefill, either reset_prefix_cache then send ONLY the pos21 request first, or set SKIP to the count of preceding nt=1 forwards.

PROVENANCE NOTE (cross-boot, feedback_no_cross_boot_byte_gate): served[0:21] used to build context must equal the splice-boot's served prefix. pos21<71 so it forks across boots; re-confirm on the splice boot that served[0:21] is identical and pos21==1970 (det_gate already shows pos21=1970, rep1==rep2). Ideally capture-and-splice within the SAME prefix family: build context from the splice boot's served_first24, OR co-capture by booting no-spec, recording served[0:21], then NOT rebooting between capture and the splice boot's prefix check. The hook re-reads the spec each forward so the splice boot reuses recur_oracle_pos21.pt without reboot via new arm_id.

SPEC FILE (hsub_spec.json) for the splice boot: {"oracle": "/logs/recur_oracle_pos21.pt", "oracle_row": <o_rows[-1]>, "forward_row": <SEARCH 0..9>, "skip": <SEARCH plausible verify-forward window>, "layers": [63] (positive control) then bisect, "field": "both", "num_tokens": 10}. oracle_row must be o_rows[-1] (the last/predicting row), NOT 0.
recon.oracleRowForPos21: oracle_row = o_rows[-1] = the LAST decoded row of the no-spec sequential decode (the row that produces pos21's next-token logits), which is also the hook DEFAULT when oracle_row is omitted (spec.get("oracle_row", o_rows[-1]) at fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:11757). For a single-token (num_tokens=1) teacher-forced decode the captured payload has rows=[0], so oracle_row=0 — but ONLY because there is exactly one row and it IS the last/predicting row; it is NOT the "row 0 = first prefill row" that v1 forced. So: set oracle_row to the LAST element of the captured oracle's rows list (o_rows[-1]); for the recommended nt=1 capture that value happens to be 0 but for the RIGHT reason (last==only row). v1's bug was forcing oracle_row=0 on the pos849 oracle whose row 0 did not predict pos21 at all. Concretely: with the nt=1 pos21 capture, leave oracle_row unset (or set to o_rows[-1]) so the hook uses the predicting row.
recon.existingOracleReusable: NOT REUSABLE — must be recaptured. recur_oracle_pos849.pt has the CORRECT structure (no-spec sequential rank-1 decode, num_tokens=1, single row, 64 layers each with hidden+residual, final_norm_hidden — exactly the FR13_HIDDEN_SUBSTITUTE schema) but the WRONG POSITION: its MRoPE positions are [849,849,849] (flat position 849), captured as part of some long sequence, with no input_ids recorded. pos21 of prompt2 is predicted at context_len ~= prompt2_len(~1024 tokens for 3379 chars) + 21 ~= ~1045, which is NOT 849; and even structurally pos849 is an arbitrary flat position unrelated to prompt2's served pos21.
